# Valid Skills

Place valid skill fixtures here. These should pass all validation.

## Subdirectories

### `minimal/`
Skills with only required frontmatter fields (name, description). No optional fields.

### `complete/`
Skills with all optional fields populated (version, author, argument-hint, examples, etc.).

### `multi-file/`
Skills that reference other files (e.g., linked documents, templates).

## Suggested Sources
- Copy minimal skills from Claude Code's built-in skills
- Copy from OpenCode registry
- Copy from OpenAI/GPT skills

Add a SKILL.md file in each subdirectory.
